result.explanation: A meta‑analysis of 21 prospective cohort studies (347,747 participants) found that higher saturated fat intake was not associated with increased coronary heart disease risk (pooled RR = 1.07, 95 % CI 0.96–1.19, P = 0.22).
result.source: Meta-analysis of prospective cohort studies evaluating the association of saturated fat with cardiovascular disease
